name: Claude Auto Marshalling
author: izicubed
description: Automatically marshals a race after its laps are saved: each pilot's stored RSSI trace is sent to the Claude API, which chooses EnterAt/ExitAt thresholds following the RotorHazard tuning methodology; the plugin recomputes laps with RotorHazard's own crossing algorithm and previews them for review before you Apply. Includes a cancellable countdown, per-pilot and whole-race manual runs, a compact live panel on the Run and Marshal pages, native graph and lap-table integration, hard Minimum-Lap-Time and self-check safeguards, and a holeshot-aware lap count. Requires an Anthropic API key.
